info.title: api2skill
info.description: Converts an OpenAPI/Swagger document into a self-contained Claude Agent Skill (SKILL.md + a runnable .cs/.fsx/.csx dispatcher + reference docs + a secrets scaffold) so an existing REST API becomes something Claude can call correctly, with authentication.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: api2skill — convert an OpenAPI/Swagger document into a Claude Agent Skill

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Generate a Claude Skill from an OpenAPI/Swagger document

options.name: --name
options.description: Override the skill name (defaults to a slug of info.title).

options.name: --script
options.description: Emitter to use: cs (default), fsx, or csx. [default: cs]

options.name: --include
options.description: Keep only matching tag:/path:/op: selectors (repeatable). [default: System.String[]]

options.name: --exclude
options.description: Drop matching tag:/path:/op: selectors (repeatable, applied after --include). [default: System.String[]]

options.name: --force
options.description: Regenerate over an existing output directory. [default: False]

options.name: --insecure
options.description: Dev-only: accept untrusted HTTPS certificates when fetching a spec URL or making generated calls. [default: False]

options.name: --format
options.description: Force the input format (json|yaml) instead of sniffing it.

options.name: --base-url
options.description: Base URL to use when the spec has no `servers` entry.

options.name: --auth-config
options.description: Path to an auth.json (explicit auth profiles) — contracts/auth-config.md. Mutually exclusive with --auth.

options.name: --auth
options.description: Shorthand: scaffold a single global auth profile of type bearer|basic|custom. oauth2/entra need --auth-config. Mutually exclusive with --auth-config.

options.name: --login
options.description: After writing the skill, run interactive login for each authorization_code auth profile. [default: False]

arguments.name: SPEC_SOURCE
arguments.description: Local file path, remote URL, or '-' for stdin.

commands.name: update
commands.description: Regenerate a previously generated skill from a newer OpenAPI/Swagger document, reusing its saved generation options.

options.name: --name
options.description: Rename the skill (same semantics as 'generate --name'). Defaults to the name recorded in .api2skill.json.

options.name: --out
options.description: Relocate the skill to a new output directory (same semantics as 'generate --out'). Defaults to <skill-path> (update in place).

arguments.name: SKILL_PATH
arguments.description: Path to a previously generated skill directory (must contain .api2skill.json).

arguments.name: SPEC_SOURCE
arguments.description: New spec source (file, URL, or '-'). Defaults to the source recorded at generation time.

commands.name: install-creator
commands.description: Install the api2skill-creator agent skill into project skill root(s).

options.name: --target
options.description: Skills root directory that will contain api2skill-creator/ (e.g. .cursor/skills). Required when stdin is not a TTY.

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite an existing api2skill-creator/SKILL.md without prompting. [default: False]
